_comment: The declared design scale. Copy this into a project as design-tokens.json and extend it with the project's own values. A value that is not in this file does not exist in the project. tokens-check.py fails the build when source uses anything else.
_units: All values are pixels at a 16px root. rem values are converted before comparison.
rules: Add a value to the scale before using it. Do not use a value that is not here.
Never write a spacing or font value as a bare rem decimal. 0.72rem renders as 11.52px.
Radius: three values maximum per surface. Pills (999px) only for a control that is genuinely round.
A baseline must pass its own gate. If a starter fails, every project built from it inherits the drift.
_project: StealthRDP: negative offsets are declared, and 999 is the pill radius for genuinely round controls.
